newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: RESEARCH ALERT - BARCLAYS BACKS P.TELECOM.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BARCLAYS BACKS P.TELECOM.

text.p: Analysts at Barclays said shares in Portugal Telecom were a medium-term buy, taking into account the group's recent international alliances, its results outlook and falling interest rates.
Although the coming third phase of the company's privatisation could cap the share's upside potential in the short term, the stock was a buy in the medium term, Barclays said in its July newsletter.
It forecast Telecom would make net profit of 64 billion escudos ($339.3 million) in 1997, rising to 74 billion in 1998 and 85 billion in 1999.
The share traded at 7,500 escudos on Tuesday, marginally up on Monday's close.
